text: 🎬 Bezos wants credit for the new 007 Jeff Bezos has publicly clarified that he had a hand in choosing Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, according to /Film. A tech billionaire taking a bow for the pick is how a franchise starts to feel like a product line.
